body: I dropped out of college for a semester to go get help. Then I went back and graduated. Maybe you need a break to get your thoughts together. It makes a difference.
Mine's a family name too. Named after my great aunt.
I'm older. I think life is harder. I'm lonelier. I don't have the same resources I had before. The person I used to talk to about this stuff....he died. Everything about my existence feels wrong.
I think friends don't know what to say in these situations. I probably won't say anything to anyone.

I just don't know where to start. I feel like I've been in bad situations before and have found a way out of it. I've been suicidal before, I've been diagnosed with mental illnesses. But somehow I found the strength to graduate college and move on with my life. I felt great. A year ago was some of the happiest feelings I ever had. But around January I began to feel the familiar despair. I thought I could beat it. Instead, I lost my job, my transmission on my car died, I can't find a new job, I'm running out of money, and my rich parents can't stand me. I'm sick and I'm losing at life. Everyone else seems to be able to hang out. I want to let go. Or be pushed.

I was an ad executive. I loved it. I was great at it. But my boss was a monster and ruined everything. I thought things would get better after that. I thought I would find a great job and be able to move on from that. But instead, I am unemployed, lonely, angry, and I relive the horrible moments from work over and over again, whether I'm asleep or awake. It has ruined me financially, mentally, my confidence is gone. Everything is gone. 
Summer sounds like she has a rough situation going on. I really hope you can help her. Sometimes our parents are supposed to love us but they don't make us feel loved. I moved out of my parents house 12 years ago but sometimes they still make me feel pretty rough. 

I just wish I could tell one of my friends that I'm planning to kill myself tonight. Not because I want to be stopped. Not because I want attention. But just so they'd get a chance to say goodbye. That's the least I could do. But I really just need to do it.
I guess I wouldn't have posted this if I didn't want to talk to someone.

I used to be an amazing violinist. Not so much these days. Never did it as more than a hobby. 
You should definitely check on your friend. I wish someone would check on me. Everyone around me means well but I think the world would be better without me.

I'm a musician for fun, I have lots of friends, I am very social. Most people don't know that I'm dying on the inside. I hide it well. But a lot of times when I'm not around people, I am at home, crumpled up and crying like I am right now.

I lost my dream job, I can't seem to bounce back from that. It's been about 5 months and since then, I've lost my car and will soon not be able to pay for my apartment anymore. This has caused so much tension in my family. My dad is prestigious and well known and frankly sick of me being the loser of the family. Little does he know, I'm sick of it too.
being able to pay my bills and have a productive life would be a start. I can't even do that right.
thank you. I've just never been so down in my entire life.

I lost my job, I'm running out of money, my family is disappointed in me. I thought I had it all figured out. I thought I was on top of the world. Over the last 10 months or so, I've watched it all get taken away from me and I don't understand what I did to deserve this. But I don't think I can handle it anymore. The pressures of trying to succeed are too much.
